showcase.user_prompt: 帮我把这个插件装到 Vetta 里。
showcase.assistant_reply: 我会先判断它是插件、Skill 还是 MCP，装完后检查是否有待应用的版本，需要重载就立刻重载并核对生效版本。

blocks.title: 把能力装对、装到生效为止

items.title: 先分类再安装
items.description: 区分插件、Skill/场景与 MCP，各走各自的安装通道。

items.title: 安装后自动重载
items.description: 覆盖升级会挂成待应用版本，识别到就立即重载并核对生效版本。

items.title: 不碰注册表
items.description: 统一经宿主审批安装，绝不手写插件目录与配置清单。

items.title: 装完就校验
items.description: 回查启用状态、版本与配置，如实报告未完成的步骤。

showcase.user_prompt: Install this plugin into Vetta for me.
showcase.assistant_reply: I'll first tell whether it is a plugin, a Skill, or an MCP server, then check for a pending version after install and reload it right away.

blocks.title: Install capabilities so they actually take effect

items.title: Classify first
items.description: Plugins, Skills/scenes, and MCP servers each have their own install path.

items.title: Reload after install
items.description: An upgrade lands as a pending version; detect it and reload, then verify the active version.

items.title: Never touch the registry
items.description: Everything goes through host approval — no hand-written plugin directories or manifests.

items.title: Verify and report
items.description: Check enabled state, version, and config, and report anything left undone.
